sqlquery.from:
(
select ccasecrmcasedetails_id, ccasecaseNumberString, ccasesubject, caseoriginname, casereasonname, typename, statusname, priorityname, assignee, resolver, receiveddate, updateddate, leadname, accname,contactname, estimateTime, workStartDate, workEndDate, customerCommitment, commitmentDate,billable ,slaName , task.name taskName, task.timespent tasktimespent ,commercial,grupo,feature from ( select ccase.id ccasecrmcasedetails_id, max(ccase.caseNumberString) ccasecaseNumberString, max(ccase.subject) ccasesubject, case ccase.billable when true then 'Yes' else 'No' end billable, max(caseorigin.name) caseoriginname, max(casereason.name) casereasonname, max(type.name) typename, max(status.name) statusname, max(priority.name) priorityname, max(coalesce(assignee.firstname,'')||' '||coalesce(assignee.lastname,'')) assignee , max(coalesce(resolver.firstname,'')||' '||coalesce(resolver.lastname,'')) resolver, max(ccase.creationDate) receiveddate, max(ccase.modificationDate) updateddate, max(coalesce(l.firstname,'')||' '||coalesce(l.lastname,'')) leadname, max(acc.name) accname , max(coalesce(contact.firstname,'') ||' '||coalesce(contact.lastname,'')) contactname , cast(max(crmcf.double_value1) as integer) estimateTime, max(crmcf.date_value1) workStartDate, max(crmcf.date_value2) workEndDate, max(crmcf.string_value1) customerCommitment, max(crmcf.date_value3) commitmentDate ,max(s.name) slaName ,max(crmcf.string_value2) commercial, max(crmcf.string_value4) grupo,max(crmcf.string_value3) feature from "$".crmcase ccase left join "$".crmcasedetails casedetails on casedetails.id = ccase.crmcasedetails_id left join "$".myuser assignee on ccase.owner = assignee.id left join "$".reference caseorigin on ccase.caseorigion = caseorigin.id left join "$".reference status on ccase.status = status.id left join "$".reference type on ccase.type = type.id left join "$".crmcontact l on ccase.lead_id = l.id left join "$".crmcontact contact on ccase.releatedto = contact.id left join "$".crmaccount acc on (ccase.crmaccount = acc.id or l.crmaccount=acc.id or contact.crmaccount=acc.id) left join "$".reference priority on ccase.priority = priority.id left join "$".reference casereason on ccase.casereason = casereason.id left join "$".myuser resolver on ccase.resolver = resolver.id
left join "$".sla s on ccase.sla=s.id
left join "$".crmcustomfields crmcf on ccase.customFields_id=crmcf.id where ccase.deleted is not true and ccase.intrash is not true group by ccase.id,ccase.billable ) cases
left join "$".relation rel on (cases.ccasecrmcasedetails_id = toid and totype='case') left join (select task.id, task.name ,sum(timesheet.timespent) as timespent from "$".timesheet timesheet left join "$".employeetask emtk on timesheet.employeetaskId=emtk.id left join "$".task task on emtk.taskid = task.id group by task.id,task.name) task on (rel.fromid = task.id and rel.fromtype='TASK')
) t
